I've gained a lot of new followers for the first time in a long time this week.

Welcome! 💜

The answers to many modern problems are simple but politically incorrect.

So instead of solving anything, everybody pretends they don't know what's going on, and spend years misdiagnosing the issue, talking in circles, and wasting time.
It's funny when people online say 'everyone' and they're talking about a dozen or so people.

I maintain that Miami is part of Latin America.


George (@BehizyTweets)

Why does no one speak English here in Miami? I thought the internet was just joking about that.

I guess it’s tolerable since none of them vote blue.



— https://nitter.net/BehizyTweets/status/2050377939481456707#m

When this is the message from 'conservative leaders' you know your country has been subverted.


Boris Johnson (@BorisJohnson)

Falling birth rates aren’t a disaster, they’re the best bit of global news in a long time

mol.im/a/15782963




— https://nitter.net/BorisJohnson/status/2050283114740511089#m

A lot has changed in my life since I posted this, but not the goal.


ZUBY: (@ZubyMusic)

If I can afford it and my future wife is willing and able, I'd like to have 5 or more children.

Many people think this is crazy. I think it's perfectly normal lol.



— https://nitter.net/ZubyMusic/status/1048634865716011008#m
God blessed you with only one body. Take care of it.
How's that 'temporary' income tax thing going?

I think it's weird to intentionally choose to end your own bloodline, but if that's what you want then it's not anybody's job to stop you.

The future will go to those who show up for it.
If you don't have a sense of humour then life is going to be particularly rough for you.
Everything is trade offs. Life is a series of trade offs.

What are the implications of this?


🇦🇪 HGS (@Sajwani)

Today the UAE 🇦🇪 officially leaves OPEC … it’s a new world !

Never bet against the UAE



— https://nitter.net/Sajwani/status/2050067215488274811#m

If enough people see your social media post, you will receive some negative comments. 

It doesn't matter how positive or uncontroversial the post is... If enough people see it, somebody will come and start hating in the comment section.
What makes you believe a statistic?
